versions.changelog:
Initial release of autoselect-skill.

- Automatically recommends relevant skills to load based on user message intent.
- Supports both auto-trigger (heuristic) and manual `/autoselect` command.
- Ranks and explains top 3 skill recommendations; outputs structured block for agent action.
- Designed to work with any agent that lists and loads skills.
- Advisory only: recommendations are not enforced, agent remains in control.
